cases.title: a flow that suspends is refused at load
a suspend in a body or the failure module is refused
without the contract entry, the subflow's suspend fails the load
with it, the subflow is opaque and the site keeps its envelope

given.contract:
roots:
  - flow: f/x/main
provided:
  - selector: {flow: f/x/main, module: permit}
    provider: approval
    mandatory: true

cases.title: a mandatory selector that matches two sites is ambiguous

files.f/x/main.flow/flow.yaml:
value:
  modules:
    - id: permit
      skip_if: {expr: 'flow_input.skip'}
      stop_after_if: {expr: 'result.denied', skip_if_stopped: false, error_message: denied}
      retry: {constant: {attempts: 2, seconds: 1}}
      continue_on_error: true
      value:
        type: flow
        path: f/x/permit
        input_transforms:
          who: {type: javascript, expr: flow_input.user}
    - id: o
      value:
        type: branchone
        branches: []
        default:
          - id: permit
            value: {type: flow, path: f/x/permit}

given.contract:
roots:
  - flow: f/x/main
provided:
  - selector: {flow: f/x/main, module: permit}
    provider: approval
    mandatory: true

cases.title: an id repeated in one list needs its occurrence

given.contract:
roots:
  - flow: f/x/main
provided:
  - selector: {flow: f/x/main, module: permit}
    provider: approval
    mandatory: true

cases.note: The selector provides the second permit step only; the first still calls f/x/permit, which is therefore loaded and validated.
cases.title: a target that another path reaches is loaded and checked

given.contract:
roots:
  - flow: f/x/main
provided:
  - selector: {flow: f/x/main, module: permit, occurrence: 1}
    provider: approval
    mandatory: true

cases.title: the occurrence selects one of the repeated ids

given.contract:
roots:
  - flow: f/x/main
provided:
  - selector: {flow: f/x/main, module: permit, occurrence: 0}
    provider: approval
    mandatory: true

cases.title: an opaque target need not be in the folder

files.f/x/main.flow/flow.yaml:
value:
  modules:
    - id: ask
      value: {type: script, path: f/x/missing}

cases.title: a selector that matches nothing is an error

files.f/x/main.flow/flow.yaml:
value:
  modules:
    - id: a
      value: {type: identity}

given.contract:
roots:
  - flow: f/x/main
provided:
  - selector: {flow: f/x/main, module: nope}
    provider: p
    mandatory: true

cases.title: a module inside an opaque flow cannot be selected

given.contract:
roots:
  - flow: f/x/main
provided:
  - selector: {flow: f/x/main, module: permit}
    provider: approval
    mandatory: true
  - selector: {flow: f/x/permit, module: wait}
    provider: p
    mandatory: true

contains: flow f/x/permit is not in the program

cases.title: a provided site must be a call site

files.f/x/main.flow/flow.yaml:
value:
  modules:
    - id: l
      value:
        type: whileloopflow
        modules: []

given.contract:
roots:
  - flow: f/x/main
provided:
  - selector: {flow: f/x/main, module: l}
    provider: p
    mandatory: true

contains: must be a script, flow or rawscript step

note: Durable suspend is out of scope (0001 §3), unless every path to it passes through a mandatory host-provided call site. The provided-site cases are the compile-time half of 0002's provided-site policy case; the run-time half is F2a's.
